ways.label: Round trip: up Avalanche Peak Track and Avalanche Peak Route, down Scotts Route and Scotts Track

via.name: Punchbowl car park
via.quote: ends at the Punchbowl car park

evidence: You have the option of tramping both routes for a round trip or going up and down the same route.
If doing the round trip, we recommend you start with the Avalanche Peak Track, which begins just behind the visitor centre.
From Arthur's Pass Visitor Centre follow the bush edge northwards to pick up the start of the track, signposted before the Glasgow Bridge over Avalanche Creek (elevation 737 m).
The track meets the road about 700 m west from the Arthur’s Pass Visitor Centre, the track then continues across the road and ends at the Punchbowl car park.

start.quote: The track start is 30 m from the Punchbowl carpark.

end.name: Avalanche Peak summit
end.quote: From the bushline to Avalanche Peak summit

evidence: For those intending to go up and down the same way, we recommend Scotts Track/Route.
Scotts Track is signposted on the main road, about 700 m west of the Arthur’s Pass Visitor Centre.
The track start is 30 m from the Punchbowl carpark.
Take note of the route up, to enable you to return the same way.

doubts: W1 is the page's round trip, recorded as a loop. The descent ends at the Punchbowl car park about 700 m west of the visitor centre and the page says the highway must not be walked, so the closing leg is not described; the loop end is set to the start to meet the loop shape, and the car park is the last via. The visitor centre start has no feature; the start ref is null. The Punchbowl car park is F2 (where Scotts Track meets the road), the nearest feature; the page says the track crosses the road to the car park. Going up and down the Avalanche Peak Route is offered in one sentence without its own heading, so it is not a separate way. DOC's time (3-4 hr to summit) and distance (2.5 km one way) cover the summit, not either full way, so way times and distances are null. Per-section times are not summed. The stray 'Cape Brett Track virtual guide' line at the end of the page is not a walk on this route and is not recorded.
